question: Does an old-selected output-frequency shift transfer beyond a same-input-frequency phase map?

design.question: Does an old-selected output-frequency shift transfer beyond a same-input-frequency phase map?
design.scope: SAVED ONLY. Native policy,16OLD FIT sources and16fresh-transfer TEST sources. No native inference, no model-weight training.
design.selection: Separately model/input-period/variant, minimize mean leave-one-SOURCE-out OLD phase-pooled waveform NMSE across all9 candidates; exact ties choose first candidate order. Refit selected candidate on all16OLD. TEST never selects periods, variants, interpolators or hyperparameters.
design.baselines: Same-input-frequency shared2x2H; old-CV-selected output-frequency2x2H; old mean32x2 odd response waveform (64 coefficients, higher capacity descriptive). Every variant retains all9 FIT-train, FIT-CV and TEST source loss curves. Tone+DC+lineartrend jointly fits4x2 maps and uses the same nuisance capacity for every candidate and same-input baseline. Mean32x2 already spans nuisance.
design.target: All4 physical incremental forecasts minus background, divided by history-only stimulus amplitude. Equal-source error pooled over4phases, normalized by total ideal INPUT-frequency signal energy; even response remains scored and cannot be fit by these odd linear maps.
design.primary: 19.2input, tone-only, TEST same-inputH minus OLD-CV-selected outputH NMSE, separately Bolt/TimesFM. Descriptive paired16384 balanced-type source bootstrap draws seed4954400; nominal95% and family2 Bonferroni97.5% percentile intervals. No automatic threshold/population claim.24h and nuisance variant descriptive.
design.identification: Report full candidate curves, selected/runner-up OLD-CV gap, source-bootstrap minimizer counts from fixed OLD-CV losses (stability only, not nested refitting or posterior), design singular values/condition, tone-subspace cosines before/after nuisance residualization, fittedH and waveform rank. No TEST minimizer is selected or promoted.
design.limitation: Only32 future samples (1to2 cycles), finite discrete candidate grid, four phases, one weak amplitude, conditional mixture types. Single-frequency projection may summarize mixed/nonstationary response. Reused TEST has prior phase-analysis exposure; exploratory saved-data transfer, not new sealed replication. Predicting model response is not improving forecasts; no identified patch causality.
design.stage_order: Prepare protocol -> tests/plants -> FIT-only selection and coefficient artifacts -> immutable FIT freeze -> TEST scoring -> independent replay -> knowledge. No native slot.

old_only_fit_freeze.selection_basis: OLD16 only; no TEST outcomes loaded by fit()

limitations: Only32 future samples (1to2 cycles), finite discrete candidate grid, four phases, one weak amplitude, conditional mixture types. Single-frequency projection may summarize mixed/nonstationary response. Reused TEST has prior phase-analysis exposure; exploratory saved-data transfer, not new sealed replication. Predicting model response is not improving forecasts; no identified patch causality.
evidence_class: Prospective saved-only hypothesis test with OLD-only selection and previously examined TEST cohort

failed_instrumentation_runs.failure: CV mutation anchor appeared twice; harness refused ambiguous replacement before running that plant.
failed_instrumentation_runs.resolution: Narrowed mutation anchor to fit_map call; clean tests and all plants rerun before FIT.

next_decision: Close output-frequency selection; no grid expansion. Separately authorized oblique-phase holdout is preparation-only and tests cardinal-phase aliasing with existing old same-frequency coefficients.

distilled_findings.interpretation: OLD-selected longer-period output maps transfer modestly beyond same-frequencyH on19.2 inputs. Bolt plain selection24 shifts to22 with DC/trend; TimesFM plain22 gains weaken under matched nuisance. Old mean32x2 waveform improves more than either single-frequency map on19.2.24hcontrol selects24 and has zero shift gain. This supports conditional waveform distortion, not a uniquely identified output oscillator or patch mechanism.
distilled_findings.identification: Every selected toneH rank2; stable coefficient estimation does not imply identified frequency. OLD runner-up gaps are small; full curves and fixed-CV bootstrap selection counts retained.32samples,1to2cycles, nuisance sensitivity, mixture-type heterogeneity and reused TEST constrain interpretation.
